title: The Dragon and the Sea Monster
lead: Ancient peoples told of a god defeating a chaos monster of the sea. The Bible echoes the picture: the great sea creatures God made (Genesis 1:21), the serpent of Eden (Genesis 3), Pharaoh as a monster in the Nile (Ezekiel 29:3), Leviathan and Rahab crushed by God (Psalm 74:13–14; Isaiah 27:1; 51:9), and in Revelation the dragon, "that ancient serpent" (Revelation 12:9).
